procedure: Create one normal-profile wired virtual controller from virtualgamepad 324d250bb01a5ddbfc1dd189513d4c9160429ee1 on x86-64 Linux 7.3.0-1-mainline with physical Valve hardware disconnected and Steam build 1794424036 open. A private source snapshot adds logging only after the codec decision: 0xae selector, declared length, payload/wire lengths and accept/reject decision; all value bytes and identities are excluded. Observe listing, dedicated Begin Test and Details. Run a bounded A/stick sample and Steam Ping, then neutralize and close twice. Source/build hashes and metadata-only totals are in evidence/steam-alpha2-ae-shapes.json.
